name: Sentence Connectivity & Linkage Analysis
description: Analyzes how individual sentences are glued together grammatically and semantically. AI language models are designed to ensure logical flow at all costs, resulting in 'hyper-connected' text where almost every sentence explicitly references the previous one, either through heavy transition words ('Therefore', 'As a result') or direct lexical repetition. Human writing often employs implicit connectivity—the writer trusts the reader's cognitive ability to jump from one concept to the next without needing a heavy-handed grammatical bridge.
algorithm: Cross-Sentence Dependency Parsing and Cohesion Scoring
mechanism: The system evaluates adjacent sentence pairs across the entire text. It looks for explicit cohesive devices (conjunctions, transitional adverbs, demonstrative pronouns like 'This' or 'These' referring to the previous sentence) and semantic overlap (repeating the same subject or verb). It calculates a 'Connectivity Density' score. AI-generated text typically scores abnormally high on this metric, displaying a mechanical, chain-link-fence structure where every sentence is tightly locked to the next. Human text is looser, featuring sentences that stand more independently.
useCase: Highly effective for evaluating academic papers, essays, and technical documentation where AI tends to over-explain the logical relationship between its own generated points.
strengths:
• Exceptional at detecting the 'smooth but soulless' feeling of AI text, diagnosing exactly why the text feels artificially perfectly structured.
• Highly resistant to simple synonym swapping, as it measures structural links rather than specific vocabularies.
limitations: • May falsely flag highly rigorous legal contracts, mathematical proofs, or step-by-step technical guides where explicit chain-link connectivity is a professional requirement.
parameters:
Analysis: Inter-Sentence Dependency and Coreference Resolution
Metric: Explicit Cohesive Device Density and Semantic Overlap
Output: 0-100 Connectivity Artificiality (Hyper-Linkage) Score
accuracy: High — 78-84% accuracy. One of the strongest indicators of text generated by models optimized for high readability and logical coherence.

references.title: Jurafsky, D. & Martin, J.H. (2024). Speech and Language Processing. 3rd Edition.
Barzilay, R. & Lapata, M. (2008). Modeling Local Coherence: An Entity-Based Approach. Computational Linguistics.
